lines.text: God tells Ezekiel he must not mourn his loss, and he must keep his turban and sandals on.
Ezekiel speaks to the people in the morning, and in the evening his brother dies.
When the people ask what his actions mean, Ezekiel says God will desecrate His sanctuary.
Ezekiel says the people will not mourn or weep, but will waste away because of their hunger.
On that day a fugitive will bring news, and Ezekiel will speak and no longer be mute.
